in_sanskrit.name: फाल्गु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a tooth like a banyan tree (shita) or the one who is as dark as a banyan tree (kantha).

in_hindi.name: फाल्गु
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाल - leaf, गु - dark colored. The one whose color is like a leaf.

in_tamil.name: பால்கு
in_tamil.meaning: பால் - leaf, கு - dark colored. The one whose color is like a leaf.

in_telugu.name: ఫాళ్గు
in_telugu.meaning: ఫాలు - leaf, గు - dark colored. The one whose color is like a leaf.

in_marathi.name: Falgu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Falgu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Falgu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vindhya’, which refers to a sacred river. It is a name of immense strength and courage, evoking the power and resilience of a flowing river.
